sloka: ततः परमसङ्क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये संस्तम्भयिषुराहवे ।। ६.९३.२७ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ paramasaṅkruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ।abravīdrakṣasāṁ madhye saṁstambhayiṣurāhave ।। 6.93.27 ।।

translations.english: To provoke Rakshasas for battle, an angry Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, spoke as follows.
